title: Prescriptions Terms: Paused Automated Refills and Strength-Error Remakes
content:
A patient may have paused the automated refilling of a Kestrel Prescriptions record — an Auto Refill or Med Sync enrollment held under Auto Refill & Medication Sync. When that prescription receives a strength-error remake, the pause earns the strength-error pause allowance.

## Terms

The strength-error pause allowance looks at an automated refill enrollment on the prescription that is paused, and at the date its pause ends:

- a pause ending **30 or more days** after today gives **5 days**;
- a pause ending **one day up to fewer than 30 days** after today gives **2 days**;
- otherwise, including where no enrollment on the prescription is paused, no days are given.

Days are calendar days counted from today, as day 0, to the date the pause ends. Each allowance day adds the prescribed daily units — the prescription's written quantity divided by its written days supply — to the strength-error remake quantity.

## Both sides of the threshold (hypothetical, today is day 0)

| Enrollment on the prescription | Pause ends | Allowance days |
|---|---|---|
| paused | day 30 | 5 |
| paused | day 29 | 2 |
| paused | day 1 | 2 |
| paused | day 0 | 0 |
| active, not paused | — | 0 |
| no enrollment | — | 0 |

**Which enrollment counts?** Only one on the same prescription, and only while its status is paused.
